name: mergeFeeds
summary: Merge K differently-shaped event streams into ONE recent-first feed, with a distinguished class PINNED above the time sort, plus a count per kind. Each stream carries its own projection to a common item so the merge never sees the source shapes — adding a stream is a (source, project) pair, not editing a growing sort. The pin is a real flag, not the `sortKey: Infinity` sentinel the harvested code used (two Infinity items compare to NaN and their order is undefined). Counts come from the merged feed in one pass, so the badge can never disagree with the list. Stable within a rank. Harvested from the Fleet page's health panel (#3462/#3465).
